Name: Haley's Argument
Author: llggw
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Haley's Argument[/b][/size][/center]

[b]EN[/b]
Haley's Argument is a small marriage event mod for Haley.

After marriage, if the farmer repeatedly stays out too late, Haley may confront them about feeling neglected. She will temporarily move back to 2 Willow Lane for a few days. During this period, the farmer can talk to her each day for special cold-war dialogue, and later trigger a short reconciliation event.

[b]中文[/b]
Haley's Argument 是一个为海莉制作的婚后小剧情 Mod。

结婚后，如果农夫多次深夜不回家，海莉会因为担心和委屈与农夫发生争吵。之后她会暂时搬回柳巷二号住几天。在这段时间里，玩家每天都可以和她触发专属冷战对白，并在第三天晚上触发和好剧情。

[size=4][b]Main Features / 主要内容[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] Adds a new marriage argument event for Haley.[/*]
[*]Adds a short three-day cold-war storyline.[/*]
[*]Adds daily special dialogue during the argument period.[/*]
[*]Haley temporarily stays at 2 Willow Lane during the storyline.[/*]
[*]Gift giving is still allowed during the cold-war period.[/*]
[*]A reconciliation event can be triggered on the third evening.[/*]
[*]Normal Haley interactions resume after reconciliation.[/*]
[*]The event can trigger again if the conditions are met in the future.[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*] 为海莉添加一段新的婚后吵架剧情。[/*]
[*]添加三天冷战时间线。[/*]
[*]冷战期间每天都有专属互动对白。[/*]
[*]剧情期间海莉会暂时住在柳巷二号。[/*]
[*]冷战期间仍然可以给海莉送礼物。[/*]
[*]第三天晚上可以触发和好剧情。[/*]
[*]和好后海莉的普通互动会恢复正常。[/*]
[*]之后如果再次满足条件，剧情可以再次触发。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Trigger Conditions / 触发条件[/b][/size]

[b]EN[/b]
The farmer must be married to Haley. 
If the farmer is away from the farmhouse at 2:00 AM three times, the argument event will become available. 
After that, leave the farmhouse in the morning between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM to trigger the argument scene.

[b]中文[/b]
玩家必须已经和海莉结婚。 
如果农夫累计三次凌晨 2:00 不在农舍内，就会满足触发条件。 
之后在早上 6:00 到下午 2:00 之间离开农舍进入农场，即可触发吵架剧情。

[size=4][b]Reconciliation / 和好剧情[/b][/size]

[b]EN[/b]
After the argument, Haley will stay at 2 Willow Lane. 
Talk to her once per day to see the special dialogue. 
On the third evening, after seeing the third-day dialogue, visit 2 Willow Lane after 6:00 PM to trigger the reconciliation event.

[b]中文[/b]
吵架后，海莉会暂时住在柳巷二号。 
玩家每天可以和她互动一次，触发当天的专属对白。 
第三天看完当天对白后，在晚上 6:00 之后前往柳巷二号，即可触发和好剧情。

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions / 安装方法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip the file.[/*]
[*]Put the [b]HaleysArgument[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*] 先安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载本 Mod。[/*]
[*]解压压缩包。[/*]
[*]将 [b]HaleysArgument[/b] 文件夹放入 Stardew Valley 的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements / 前置需求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] SMAPI[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility Notes / 兼容性说明[/b][/size]

[b]EN[/b]
During the cold-war period, this mod temporarily controls Haley's normal interaction so the story dialogue can work correctly. Gift giving remains available.

Most mods that use the normal NPC interaction system should be compatible. However, mods that completely replace or bypass NPC interaction may not be fully blocked during the storyline.

[b]中文[/b]
冷战期间，本 Mod 会暂时接管海莉的普通互动，以保证剧情对白正常触发。送礼功能仍然保留。

大多数使用正常 NPC 互动系统的 Mod 应该可以兼容。但如果某些 Mod 完全绕过原版 NPC 互动逻辑，可能无法被完全屏蔽。
